Website at the foot of the side menu opens NorthRay Software's website in your browser, and Settings › About has Visit the website too.
Buttons have Writing Studio's calm look: one style everywhere, a soft frame that lifts when you point at it, and a small icon beside the words where there's room.
Faint text is a little darker in the light theme and a little lighter in the dark one, so it reads easily (WCAG AA), and the light theme's green is deeper for the same reason.

NorthRay is NorthRay's apps only: the community and radio apps are gone from the catalogue, the website and the code, along with every mention of them. Copies already installed aren't removed, but they won't be updated.

Jump back in on the home page: the books you last wrote in (cover, series and the chapter you were on) open Writing Studio at that chapter, and NorthRay Capture's card opens it on the scene it was on, or another of its scenes from Other scenes.
The tray menu has Continue writing, with the same books, and Open Capture on, with Capture's scenes.
Settings has a switch for Jump back in. It reads Writing Studio's and Capture's own files on this PC and nothing else.

NorthRay Launcher can keep running in the notification area when you close its window, so updates still install. Its icon there opens your apps and quits the launcher.
